title: Namespace capacity
description: CPU, memory and throttling per namespace. Assumes cAdvisor container_cpu_usage_seconds_total, container_memory_working_set_bytes, container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total, container_cpu_cfs_periods_total, container_network_receive_bytes_total and container_network_transmit_bytes_total, and kube-state-metrics kube_pod_info, kube_pod_container_resource_requests, kube_pod_container_resource_limits, kube_node_status_allocatable and kube_node_status_condition. Choose the namespace after importing.

widgets.title: CPU periods throttled
widgets.description: Share of CPU scheduling periods in which containers hit their limit. Sustained throttling means limits are below what the workload needs.

widgets.title: CPU use against requests
widgets.description: CPU use as a share of the CPU requested by each pod. A pod with no CPU request has no series here. Above 100% the pod uses more than it reserved.

widgets.title: Workload placement by node
widgets.query: label_replace(max by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu",unit="core"}) and on (node) count by (node) (kube_pod_info{namespace={{namespace}},node!=""}), "signal", "cpu-allocatable", "", "") or label_replace(max by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory",unit="byte"}) and on (node) count by (node) (kube_pod_info{namespace={{namespace}},node!=""}), "signal", "memory-allocatable", "", "") or label_replace(sum by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace={{namespace}},resource="cpu",unit="core"}), "signal", "cpu-request", "", "") or label_replace(sum by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace={{namespace}},resource="memory",unit="byte"}), "signal", "memory-request", "", "") or label_replace(max by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready",status="true"}) and on (node) count by (node) (kube_pod_info{namespace={{namespace}},node!=""}), "signal", "node-ready", "", "")

widgets.title: Requests and usage by pod
widgets.query: label_replace(sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace={{namespace}},container!="",container!="POD"}[5m])), "signal", "cpu-usage", "", "") or label_replace(sum by (pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace={{namespace}},container!="",container!="POD",resource="cpu",unit="core"}), "signal", "cpu-request", "", "") or label_replace(sum by (pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace={{namespace}},resource="cpu",unit="core"}), "signal", "cpu-limit", "", "") or label_replace(sum by (pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace={{namespace}},container!="",container!="POD"}), "signal", "memory-usage", "", "") or label_replace(sum by (pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace={{namespace}},container!="",container!="POD",resource="memory",unit="byte"}), "signal", "memory-request", "", "") or label_replace(sum by (pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace={{namespace}},resource="memory",unit="byte"}), "signal", "memory-limit", "", "")
